verdict.rationale: Bento defines Segments as saved filters (bento-docs-42) and advertises a 'describe what you want in plain text and let Bento's AI build it for you' feature (bento-docs-10) plus programmatic surfaces (MCP, CLI, API) that can access subscribers, tags, and broadcasts (bento-docs-5, bento-docs-49, bento-docs-34). However, no evidence explicitly ties the plain-text AI builder to segment creation via MCP/CLI/API, nor shows a documented segment-creation endpoint or agent workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a segment-creation API/MCP command, and a concrete example of an agent turning a plain-language description into a saved segment.
